items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: I used to go hang out with a cat named Bud Bennett; he played piano on the radio. So I'd go and play with him

ctx.x: This was... Oh, man, years! I have to stop and think about that. Let's see, what year was it? It was in '34 or '35, somewhere along there. And we went to Ada and played for this dime a dance thing, which was horrible, but I mean, at least it was some money. We were making enough money to eat and so forth.
And I used to go hang out with a cat named Bud Bennett; he played piano on the radio. So I'd go and play with him just so that I could get people to get to know who I was...
You played with him on the radio program?
